name: California Attorney General Data Security Breach List
regulator: California Department of Justice, Office of the Attorney General
unit_of_observation: One row in the official full data breach CSV
source_threshold: The source list concerns sample notices submitted when more than 500 California residents are notified.
source_population: Organizations that sent sample breach notices published by the California Attorney General.
source_licence: California Department of Justice website content is considered public domain, subject to third-party exclusions.
attribution: State of California Department of Justice, Office of the Attorney General
correction_process: Check the current official CSV and list page; do not retrieve or reproduce sample notification letters.
limitations: The organization is the source-labelled notifier and may not be the entity where the event occurred.
The current official CSV includes one historical row where the organization name is omitted; Breach Gazette preserves that state without creating an organization identity.
The CSV has no stable source record identifier or detail URL.
Breach Gazette does not retrieve sample notification letters.
